spec_match.rationale: Real PerformanceObserver over layout-shift; scores and rects come from the live entry; the pre-145 panel is an explicitly labelled DPR-squared simulation.

interactive.rationale: Distance slider, DPR simulation buttons and delayed trigger all work; trusted CDP click populated score 0.0012 and the log — previously the score stayed '—' forever because the immediate shift was input-attributed.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Lede matches the CSS-pixel change and the added note explains why the shift is deliberately delayed.

edge_cases.rationale: Log now labels page-load/buffered entries separately from requested shifts and reports the MEASURED movement from the entry's own rects (fixing the 'shift 100px' mislabel), but the stage's overflow clipping can make measured movement smaller than requested (observed 80px vs 100px requested) — labelled, not hidden.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Trusted CDP click: countdown, shift fired, score 0.0012, log row 'moved 80px (requested 100px)' with prev/curr y; pre-145 sim updated (0.0047 at DPR2); mobile 360 clean; console clean except environmental fonts request; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Page has no explicit showcaseTelemetry asserts of its own; server-injected demo telemetry only.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables; trigger button colour override sets both background and color.

accessibility.rationale: Status text plus a visually-hidden polite announce region for scheduled/fired; countdown ticks not announced; slider and buttons have accessible names.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: scrollWidth 360 at 360x740 DPR3; desktop 1280 exercised via CDP; screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Size the stage so the full requested distance is observable
openQuestions.detail: With overflow:hidden and min-height 200px the element's measured shift (from entry rects) can be less than the slider's requested distance (80 vs 100 observed). Either grow the stage with the distance or explain the clip inline next to the slider.

openQuestions.title: Add a page-level telemetry assert
openQuestions.detail: Assert that a triggered shift produced a counted entry (and separately that no entry arrived while pending) so production regressions of the input-attribution window logic are observable.

guidanceConsulted.query: status updates aria-live countdown delayed action
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Centralize announcements in a single polite live region; do not announce interstitial ticks or spam live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Visible 0.1s countdown updates a plain status element; a separate visually-hidden aria-live=polite region receives only scheduled/fired/captured messages.

summary: Fixed both reported defects: the dead readout (immediate click-shifts were hadRecentInput:true and filtered — now the shift fires 0.7s after the click with a visible countdown) and the log mislabel (entries are now labelled with the measured movement from their own rects, and buffered page-load shifts are marked as such instead of claiming the slider distance). Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via raw CDP (trusted Input.dispatchMouseEvent clicks, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile + 1280x800 desktop emulation, screenshots read) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so 145-only success paths were validated on their honest fallback branches. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental and not counted against the page.
